title: Runtime consulting lifecycle — prevent infinite 'consultando...'
description: Every chat/external dispatch must reach a terminal state. Timeout watchdog + dispatch_id guards prevent the UI from staying in busy/consultando indefinitely.
resume_hint: P0.5 adds OSES learning loop: repeated shared_reality_handoff events generate structured findings that feed PortableContext. Lifecycle terminal with causal explanation (P0.4) + OSES learning from repetition (P0.5). Code audit passed (286 tests). Awaiting live Windows run.
next_action: User runs IABV on Windows with P0.3+P0.4 merged, sends chat, verifies latestDispatchLifecycle shows real cycle, confirms no infinite consultando. Then mark COMPLETED.

metadata.coverage_detail: Timeout watchdog (120s chat, 180s external), dispatch_id stale-result guards, 8 terminal states defined, _humanize_task_failure classifier, _human_external_consultation_failure structured handoff.
metadata.p01_additions: Runtime audit trace on all terminal events (trace_dispatch_terminal). adaptive_action now guarded with dispatch_id + timeout watchdog. external_consultation blocked derives terminal_state from payload.meta.
metadata.p02_additions: trace_dispatch_started() on chat, external_consultation, adaptive_action. recent_dispatch_lifecycles() correlates started→terminal with duration_ms and unresolved flag. latestDispatchLifecycle read-only Property exposed. Orphan terminals deprioritized. New unresolved dispatch visible over old correlated.
metadata.p03_additions: Visual evidence validation prevents treating black/offscreen captures as successful completion. consultation_metadata.status='visual_unresolved' when capture is invalid — lifecycle correctly reaches terminal state with actionable handoff instead of false 'success'.
metadata.p04_additions: Shared reality causal handoff: when visual evidence fails and user reports mismatch ('a mí sí me funciona'), lifecycle terminal includes causal explanation (Tu vista vs Vista de IABV), browser/profile identification, evidence path, and RuntimeAuditTracer shared_reality_handoff event. No false success, no silent failure, no infinite consultando.
metadata.p05_additions: OSES reads shared_reality_handoff events and detects repeated patterns. If lifecycle terminals repeatedly involve visual mismatches, OSES generates findings with frequency, evidence, and recommended actions. PortableContext exports compact learning summary.
metadata.p012_additions: PR #390 adds runtime_build_fingerprint, stale-code live-proof invalidation, post-consultation dock refresh cooldown, security-verification terminal handoff/retest, and enriched freeze context. Live proof remains blocked until the user runs Windows main with this build.

p012_stale_build_policy.reason: A live run on a stale branch/head cannot validate #381-#390 fixes and must be treated as invalid evidence, not as a functional regression.

p013_stale_shortcut_policy.reason: The desktop shortcut launched scripts/IABV.vbs in a workspace on codex/control-center-live-freeze-fix while origin/main already contained #390. start_iabv.ps1 now blocks non-main stale runtime unless explicitly allowed.
p013_stale_shortcut_policy.required_user_visible_behavior: If the shortcut points to a non-main stale branch, show a Windows popup and do not start the stale UI silently.

metadata.p03_live_proof_detail: Runtime cycle did not freeze, but visual handoff failed: ChatGPT window was offscreen (rect=[-32000,-32000,199,34]), capture was black (blank_probability=0.98), status was incorrectly reported as visual_captured. P0.3 fix: status now correctly set to visual_unresolved with guided handoff message.
metadata.p04_live_proof_pending: Shared reality causal handoff — user says 'a mí sí me funciona', IABV responds with causal explanation instead of generic message

code_audit.reason_no_live_proof: Logs are from 2026-04-18, before #377/#378/#379. User has not yet run the app with P0.2 code on Windows.

remaining: Live UI proof with real user interaction on Windows
